**Kids & Me.**
- 
Halton Region's page lists the Acton Branch group on Thursdays from 10:30 a.m. to 12 p.m.

- 
These groups follow the school calendar and are closed during the December/January holidays, spring/summer breaks and all statutory holidays.

- 
It follows a routine with a time for play, snacks and stories.

- 
The library describes it as a free weekly 1.5-hour drop-in for families with babies or children up to 6 years of age.

- I didn't pull a price from Halton Region's own page, so I left the price blank in the pick.

**EarlyON (Links2Care).**
- 
Links2Care offers free programs for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers in Halton Hills.

- 
The programs run weekdays, weekends and evenings, and include drop-in and registered sessions.

- 
Locations include Acton and Georgetown.

- Their page has a "Current Schedule" section, but my search only returned a snippet, so I couldn't read specific days or times. Check that page, or call, before you go.
